change: E022 with ENet replaced by the plain 2D U-Net from E010. All non-model settings are identical: recovered four-organ HU-windowed data and split, CE+Dice loss, augmentation with elastic disabled, 75 epochs, batch size 8, lr 5e-4, seed 123, one-slice input, and num_workers 0.
hypothesis: The U-Net's skip connections and much larger capacity improve or at least match E022's four-organ performance when every other training variable is fixed.

dataset.name: SEGTHOR_aorta_huwide
dataset.source: segthor_part1 (GT class 1 split back into esophagus + aorta)

what_to_check: The preflight output must initialize CEDiceLoss and execute one augmented batch on CUDA.
Compare all 3D metrics and per-patient Dice directly with E022: dataset, split, loss, augmentation, epoch budget, seed, and batch size are fixed.
Report model capacity and training time alongside accuracy: U-Net has 7,762,135 parameters versus E022 ENet's 284,003.
Inspect Patient_15 esophagus, the persistent thin-organ failure in E017 through E023.

comparison_to_E022.protocol: All data, split, loss, augmentation, epoch, batch-size, seed, and worker settings are identical; only the architecture differs.
comparison_to_E022.interpretation: U-Net improves the mean Dice of every organ over E022: foreground 0.781 versus 0.757, with the largest gain on esophagus (0.561 versus 0.491). NSD also improves for every organ. Boundary distance is mixed: esophagus and heart improve, while trachea and aorta HD95 are higher. Patient_15 esophagus remains the dominant failure (Dice 0.034, HD95 150.5 mm). This is a controlled single-seed comparison, but the E022 per-patient metrics CSV was not retained locally after artifact cleanup, so no paired significance statistic is claimed.
